098        public LuddicPathCellsIntel(MarketAPI market, boolean sleeper) {
099                this.market = market;
100                this.sleeper = sleeper;
101                
102                if (!market.isPlayerOwned()) {
103                        setPostingLocation(market.getPrimaryEntity());
104                }
105                
106                if (!market.hasCondition(Conditions.PATHER_CELLS)) {
107                        market.addCondition(Conditions.PATHER_CELLS, this);
108                }
109                
110                Global.getSector().addScript(this);
111                
112                if (market.isPlayerOwned() || DebugFlags.PATHER_BASE_DEBUG) {
113                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this);
114                } else {
115                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().queueIntel(this);
116                }
117        }

119        public static LuddicPathBaseIntel getClosestBase(MarketAPI market) {
120                List<IntelInfoPlugin> bases = Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(LuddicPathBaseIntel.class);
121                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
122                LuddicPathBaseIntel closest = null;
123                for (IntelInfoPlugin curr : bases) {
124                        LuddicPathBaseIntel intel = (LuddicPathBaseIntel) curr;
125                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(intel.getMarket().getLocationInHyperspace(), market.getLocationInHyperspace());
126                        if (dist < minDist) {
127                                minDist = dist;
128                                closest = intel;
129                        }
130                }
131                return closest;
132        }
133        
134        public static List<LuddicPathCellsIntel> getCellsForBase(LuddicPathBaseIntel base, boolean includeSleeper) {
135                List<LuddicPathCellsIntel> result = new ArrayList<LuddicPathCellsIntel>();
136                
137                List<IntelInfoPlugin> cells = Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(LuddicPathCellsIntel.class);
138                for (IntelInfoPlugin curr : cells) {
139                        LuddicPathCellsIntel intel = (LuddicPathCellsIntel) curr;
140                        if (!includeSleeper && intel.isSleeper()) continue;
141                        if (getClosestBase(intel.getMarket()) == base) {
142                                result.add(intel);
143                        }
144                }
145                return result;
146        }

148        public static LuddicPathCellsIntel getCellsForMarket(MarketAPI market) {
149                if (market == null) return null;
150                List<IntelInfoPlugin> cells = Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(LuddicPathCellsIntel.class);
151                for (IntelInfoPlugin curr : cells) {
152                        LuddicPathCellsIntel intel = (LuddicPathCellsIntel) curr;
153                        if (intel.getMarket() == market) return intel;
154                }
155                return null;
156        }

201        @Override
202        protected void advanceImpl(float amount) {
203                super.advanceImpl(amount);
204                
205                float days = Misc.getDays(amount);
206                
207                inertiaTime += days;
208                
209                if (sleeperTimeout > 0) {
210                        sleeperTimeout -= days;
211                        if (sleeperTimeout < 0) {
212                                sleeperTimeout = 0;
213                        }
214                }
215                
216                if (!market.isInEconomy()) {
217                        endImmediately();
218                        return;
219                }
220                
221                if (isSleeper()) return;
222                
223                // incidents handled through HostileActivityEventIntel now
224                // not anymore since the change from Hostile Activity -> Colony Crises
225                //if (market.isPlayerOwned()) return;
226                
227                if (DebugFlags.PATHER_BASE_DEBUG) {
228                        days *= 200f;
229                }
230                
231                if (prevIncident != null) {
232                        float mult = 1f;
233                        if (DebugFlags.PATHER_BASE_DEBUG) {
234                                mult = 1f / 20f;
235                        }
236                        sincePrevIncident += days * mult;
237                        if (sincePrevIncident >= 180f) {
238                                sincePrevIncident = 0f;
239                                prevIncident = null;
240                                prevIncidentData = null;
241                                prevIncidentSucceeded = false;
242                        }
243                }
244//              if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
245//                      System.out.println("wefwefwe");
246//              }
247                if (incidentType == null && prevIncident == null) {
248                        incidentTracker.advance(days);
249                        if (incidentTracker.intervalElapsed() && random.nextFloat() < INCIDENT_PROB) {
250                                prepareIncident();
251                                numIncidentAttempts++;
252                        }
253                } else if (incidentType != null) {
254                        if (incidentDelay > 0 && smuggler == null) {
255                                incidentDelay -= days;
256                        }
257                        
258                        if (smuggler == null && incidentDelay <= 0) {
259                                beginIncident();
260                        }
261//                              if(market.isPlayerOwned()) {
262//                                      System.out.println("efwwefew");
263//                              }
264//                      smuggler.getActiveFleet().getLocation()
265//                      smuggler.getActiveFleet().getContainingLocation()
266                        if (smuggler != null) {
267                                RouteSegment segment = smuggler.getCurrent();
268                                if (segment != null && segment.getId() == EconomyFleetRouteManager.ROUTE_TRAVEL_SRC) {
269//                                      if(market.isPlayerOwned()) {
270//                                              System.out.println("efwwefew");
271//                                      }
272                                        doIncident();
273                                }
274                        }
275                }
276        }

279        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
280                
281                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
282                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
283                float pad = 3f;
284                float opad = 10f;
285                
286                float initPad = pad;
287                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
288                
289                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
290                
291                bullet(info);
292                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
293                
294                if (mode != ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
295                        addMarketToList(info, market, initPad, tc);
296                        initPad = 0f;
297                }
298                //info.addPara(market., initPad)
299                
300                if (isUpdate) {
301                        if (getListInfoParam() == INCIDENT_HAPPENED) {
302                                if (!prevIncidentSucceeded) {
303                                        info.addPara("Incident averted by local security forces", initPad);
304                                } else {
305                                        switch (prevIncident) {
306                                        case INDUSTRY_SABOTAGE:
307                                                Industry ind = (Industry) prevIncidentData;
308                                                String days = getDays(ind.getDisruptedDays());
309                                                String daysStr = getDaysString(ind.getDisruptedDays());
310                                                info.addPara(ind.getCurrentName() + " operations disrupted for %s " + daysStr, initPad, tc, h, days);
311                                                break;
312                                        case REDUCED_STABILITY:
313                                                info.addPara("Stability reduced by %s", initPad, tc, h, "" + (Integer) prevIncidentData);
314                                                break;
315                                        case PLANETBUSTER:
316                                                info.addPara("Colony destroyed by planetbuster", initPad, tc);
317                                                break;
318                                        }
319                                }
320                        }
321                }
322                
323                unindent(info);
324        }

333        public void addInterestInfo(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
334                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
335                float opad = 10f;
336                
337                info.addSectionHeading("Pather interest", getFactionForUIColors().getBaseUIColor(),
338                                  getFactionForUIColors().getDarkUIColor(), Alignment.MID, opad);
339                
340                info.addPara("The following activity is attracting Pather interest, whether due to AI core use or the inherent nature of the industry:", opad);
341                
342                List<Industry> industries = new ArrayList<Industry>(market.getIndustries());
343                Iterator<Industry> iter = industries.iterator();
344                while (iter.hasNext()) {
345                        if (iter.next().isHidden()) {
346                                iter.remove();
347                        }
348                }
349                Collections.sort(industries, new Comparator<Industry>() {
350                        public int compare(Industry o1, Industry o2) {
351                                float s1 = o1.getPatherInterest();
352                                float s2 = o2.getPatherInterest();
353                                return (int) Math.signum(s2 - s1);
354                        }
355                });
356                String indent = "    ";
357                float initPad = 5f;
358                boolean added = false;
359                
360                String aiCoreId = market.getAdmin().getAICoreId();
361                if (aiCoreId != null) {
362                        int s = (int) Math.round(LuddicPathBaseManager.AI_CORE_ADMIN_INTEREST);
363                        if (market.getAdmin().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.SUSPECTED_AI)) {
364                                info.addPara(indent + "Suspected AI core administrator (%s)", initPad, h, "" + s);
365                        } else {
366                                info.addPara(indent + "AI core administrator (%s)", initPad, h, "" + s);
367                        }
368                        initPad = 3f;
369                        added = true;
370                }
371                
372                for (Industry ind : industries) {
373                        //float score = LuddicPathBaseManager.getLuddicPathMarketInterest(market);
374                        float score = ind.getPatherInterest();
375                        if ((int)Math.round(score) != 0) {
376                                int s = (int) Math.round(score);
377                                info.addPara(indent + ind.getCurrentName() + " (%s)", initPad, h, "" + s);
378                                initPad = 3f;
379                                added = true;
380                        }
381                }
382                
383                
384                
385                if (!added) {
386                        info.addPara(indent + "None", initPad);
387                }
388                
389                if (market.isPlayerOwned() && LuddicPathHostileActivityFactor.isPlayerDefeatedPatherExpedition()) {
390                        info.addPara("You defeated a Luddic Path armada sent against you, and " 
391                                        + "they are now more reluctant to take active measures against your colonies.", opad);
392                }
393                
394        }

546        public List<ArrowData> getArrowData(SectorMapAPI map) {
547                if (sleeperTimeout > 0) return null;
548                
549                LuddicPathBaseIntel base = LuddicPathCellsIntel.getClosestBase(market);
550                if (base == null || !base.isPlayerVisible()) return null;
551                
552                List<ArrowData> result = new ArrayList<ArrowData>();
553                
554                
555                SectorEntityToken entityFrom = base.getMapLocation(map);
556                if (map != null) {
557                        SectorEntityToken iconEntity = map.getIntelIconEntity(base);
558                        if (iconEntity != null) {
559                                entityFrom = iconEntity;
560                        }
561                }
562                
563                ArrowData arrow = new ArrowData(entityFrom, market.getPrimaryEntity());
564                arrow.color = getFactionForUIColors().getBaseUIColor();
565                result.add(arrow);
566                
567                return result;
568        }

598        public String getName() {
599                String base = "Luddic Path Cells";
600                
601                if (isSendingUpdate()) {
602                        if (getListInfoParam() == INCIDENT_HAPPENED) {
603                                if (prevIncidentSucceeded) {
604                                        return base + " - Incident";
605                                } else {
606                                        return base + " - Incident Averted";
607                                }
608                        }
609                }
610                
611                if (isEnding()) {
612                        return base + " - Dissolved";
613                }
614                if (sleeperTimeout > 0) {
615                        return base + " - Disrupted";
616                }
617                if (isSleeper()) {
618                        return base + " - Sleeper";
619                } else {
620                        return base + " - Active";
621                }
622        }

672        public void prepareIncident() {
673                abortIncident();
674                //if (incidentType != null) return;
675                LuddicPathBaseIntel base = LuddicPathCellsIntel.getClosestBase(getMarket());
676                if (base == null) return;
677                
678                WeightedRandomPicker<IncidentType> types = new WeightedRandomPicker<IncidentType>(random);
679                
680                types.add(IncidentType.REDUCED_STABILITY, 10f);
681                if (numIncidentAttempts >= 3 || !market.isPlayerOwned()) {
682                        types.add(IncidentType.INDUSTRY_SABOTAGE, 10f);
683                }
684                
685//              if (numIncidentAttempts >= 10 && market.getSize() >= 5 && 
686//                              !Global.getSector().getMemory().is(USED_PLANETBUSTER_KEY, true)) {
687//                      types.add(IncidentType.PLANETBUSTER, 5f);
688//              }
689                
690                incidentType = types.pick();
691                //incidentType = IncidentType.REDUCED_STABILITY;
692                incidentDelay = MIN_WARNING_DAYS + random.nextFloat() * MIN_WARNING_DAYS;
693                
694                
695                if (incidentType == IncidentType.PLANETBUSTER) {
696                        incidentDelay = MIN_WARNING_DAYS * 4f + random.nextFloat() * 30f;
697                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(USED_PLANETBUSTER_KEY, true, 1500f);
698                }
699                
700//              if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
701//                      sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(INCIDENT_PREP, false);
702//              }
703        }

714        
715        public void abortIncident() {
716                incidentDelay = 0;
717                incidentType = null;
718                if (smuggler != null && smuggler.getActiveFleet() != null) {
719                        smuggler.getActiveFleet().removeEventListener(this);
720                }
721                smuggler = null;
722        }
723        
724        protected boolean checkSuccess() {
725                float pSuccess = 1f - market.getStabilityValue() * 0.075f;
726                return random.nextFloat() < pSuccess;
727        }
728        
729        public void doIncident() {
730                if (incidentType == null) return;
731                
732                prevIncidentData = null;
733                
734                boolean success = checkSuccess();
735                
736                if (incidentType == IncidentType.REDUCED_STABILITY) {
737                        if (success) {
738                                RecentUnrest.get(market).add(3, 
739                                                Misc.ucFirst(Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH).getPersonNamePrefix()) + " sabotage");
740                                prevIncidentData = 3;
741                        }
742                } else if (incidentType == IncidentType.INDUSTRY_SABOTAGE) {
743                        WeightedRandomPicker<Industry> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<Industry>(random);
744                        for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
745                                if (!ind.canBeDisrupted()) continue;
746                                picker.add(ind, ind.getPatherInterest());
747                        }
748                        Industry target = picker.pick();
749                        if (target == null) {
750                                abortIncident();
751                                return;
752                        }
753                        
754                        prevIncidentData = target;
755                        if (success) {
756                                float disruptionDur = MIN_SABOTAGE + random.nextFloat() * (MAX_SABOTAGE - MIN_SABOTAGE);
757                                target.setDisrupted(disruptionDur, true);
758                        }
759                } else if (incidentType == IncidentType.PLANETBUSTER) {
760                        // ??? turn into lava planet, remove market, etc
761                }
762                
763                prevIncident = incidentType;
764                sincePrevIncident = 0f;
765                prevIncidentSucceeded = success;
766                
767                
768                if (DebugFlags.SEND_UPDATES_WHEN_NO_COMM || Global.getSector().getIntelManager().isPlayerInRangeOfCommRelay() 
769                                || market.isPlayerOwned()) {
770                        if (market.isPlayerOwned() || 
771                                        incidentType == IncidentType.INDUSTRY_SABOTAGE ||
772                                        incidentType == IncidentType.PLANETBUSTER) {
773                                sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(INCIDENT_HAPPENED, false);
774                        }
775                }
776                
777                abortIncident();
778        }

780        
781        protected void sendSmuggler(LuddicPathBaseIntel base) {
782                String sid = getRouteSourceId();
783                
784                SectorEntityToken from = base.getMarket().getPrimaryEntity();
785                SectorEntityToken to = getMarket().getPrimaryEntity();
786                
787                EconomyRouteData data = new EconomyRouteData();
788                data.from = base.getMarket();
789                data.to = market;
790                data.smuggling = true;
791                data.cargoCap = 400;
792                data.fuelCap = 200;
793                
794                OptionalFleetData extra = new OptionalFleetData(data.from);
795                extra.fleetType = FleetTypes.TRADE_SMUGGLER;
796                
797                RouteData route = RouteManager.getInstance().addRoute(sid, base.getMarket(), Misc.genRandomSeed(), extra, this, data);
798                extra.strength = 50f;
799                extra.strength = Misc.getAdjustedStrength(extra.strength, base.getMarket());
800                
801                
802                float orbitDays = 3f + random.nextFloat() * 3f;
803                float travelDays = RouteLocationCalculator.getTravelDays(from, to);
804                if (DebugFlags.PATHER_BASE_DEBUG) travelDays *= 0.1f;
805                
806                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(EconomyFleetRouteManager.ROUTE_SRC_LOAD, orbitDays, from));
807                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(EconomyFleetRouteManager.ROUTE_TRAVEL_DST, travelDays, from, to));
808                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(EconomyFleetRouteManager.ROUTE_DST_UNLOAD, orbitDays * 0.5f, to));
809                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(EconomyFleetRouteManager.ROUTE_DST_LOAD, orbitDays * 0.5f, to));
810                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(EconomyFleetRouteManager.ROUTE_TRAVEL_SRC, travelDays, to, from));
811                route.addSegment(new RouteSegment(EconomyFleetRouteManager.ROUTE_SRC_UNLOAD, orbitDays, from));
812                
813                smuggler = route;
814        }

828        public CampaignFleetAPI spawnFleet(RouteData route) {
829                Random random = new Random();
830                if (route.getSeed() != null) {
831                        random = new Random(route.getSeed());
832                }
833                
834                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = EconomyFleetRouteManager.createTradeRouteFleet(route, random);
835                if (fleet == null) return null;;
836                
837                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_DO_NOT_IGNORE_PLAYER, true);
838                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS, true);
839                fleet.addEventListener(this);
840                fleet.addScript(new EconomyFleetAssignmentAI(fleet, route));
841                return fleet;
842        }

844        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
845                if (smuggler == null || smuggler.getActiveFleet() == null) return;
846                
847                CampaignFleetAPI active = smuggler.getActiveFleet();
848                if (!battle.isInvolved(active)) return;
849                
850                if (battle.getSideFor(active) != battle.getSideFor(primaryWinner)) {
851                        abortIncident();
852                }
853        }
